items.title: Large Language Models: A Map with Theseus
items.summary: Bilingual, in English and Italian: an interactive hand-drawn map of the ideas behind large language models, in fifteen stops — what a generative model is, how text becomes tokens, what temperature does, how a language model turns into an assistant and then into an agent, and why a fluent answer can still be wrong. Each stop carries a small experiment to play with.

items.title: A Map of Artificial Intelligence
items.summary: An interactive hand-drawn map of the history of artificial intelligence. Nineteen stops along a trail that climbs from Ada Lovelace's Note G in 1843 to ChatGPT, over the hills of each AI summer and down into the two snowy winters.

items.title: Darwin è superato e altre bugie che la scuola non dovrebbe tollerare
items.summary: La scuola italiana tollera falsità scientifiche (come Darwin è superato) diffuse da coach e counsellor invitati come esperti. Confonde educazione con persuasione, sostituendo rigore epistemologico con tecniche motivazionali. Serve fact-checking sugli esterni, privilegiando credenziali accademiche verificabili. La posta in gioco: formare pensiero critico autonomo, non consumatori di narrative preconfezionate.

items.title: Nils Aall Barricelli: A Pioneer of Digital Artificial Life
items.summary: Nils Aall Barricelli, pioneer of digital evolution, created numerical organisms capable of reproducing and evolving, anticipating artificial intelligence and artificial life. His research, initially unrecognized, is now acknowledged as fundamental to computer science development.

items.title: An Introduction to Large Language Models
items.summary: A clear and accessible introduction to the language models behind ChatGPT and other AI assistants, featuring Andrej Karpathy's excellent explainer on System 1 vs System 2 thinking in AI.

items.title: Why Teach Artificial Intelligence in Schools
items.summary: The motivations for why AI must enter traditional school subjects. Exploring the relationship between humans and computers, and why AI literacy is essential for all citizens, not just future scientists.

items.title: Simulating the Second Law of Thermodynamics
items.summary: An agent-based simulation exploring the second law of thermodynamics through a money exchange model. Discover how entropy increases and equilibrium distributions emerge from simple random interactions.

items.title: Artificial Intelligence in High School Education
items.summary: A textbook on artificial intelligence for high school students, covering history, ethics, Python programming, data science tools, and machine learning with scikit-learn.

items.title: Dielectric Breakdown Simulation
items.summary: A computational model simulating fractal patterns formed during dielectric breakdown, implementing the Pietronero model to generate structures similar to lightning and electrical treeing.
